data.name: Aabis
data.gender_notes: Aabis is used as a male name in Arabic naming tradition.
data.long_meaning: Aabis (عابس) is an Arabic name meaning “Frowning; austere; stern-faced; grimly serious”. It is the active participle of ʿabasa 'to frown, to scowl, to look austere', from the root ʿ-b-s. The Arabic verb ʿabasa specifically describes a frowning or stern expression; the name therefore denotes someone of severe or austere bearing rather than a moral quality.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabis carries the meaning Frowning; austere; stern-faced. This is a descriptive lexical sense, not a religious attribute; any spiritual reading placed on the name is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿābis (عابس) 'frowning, austere', active participle of ʿabasa 'to frown', from the root ʿ-b-s.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabis total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aabis mean?
faq.a: Aabis means Frowning; austere; stern-faced; grimly serious.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aabis?
What language does the name Aabis come from?
Is Aabis a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabis is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aabis written in Arabic?
faq.a: Aabis is written عابس in Arabic and Urdu.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aabis?
faq.a: The root of Aabis is ʿ-b-s (ع-ب-س), from ʿābis (عابس).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aabis?
faq.a: From Arabic ʿābis (عابس) frowning, austere, the active participle of ʿabasa, to frown.

faq.q: Does Aabis appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabis is not itself a Qur'anic name; it is an established classical Arabic vocabulary word.
Not exactly. ʿAbasa denotes a frowning or stern facial expression and an austere bearing, rather than anger itself.

faq.q: Is Aabis a positive or negative name?
faq.a: It is a descriptive name, not a moral judgement. It denotes austerity and seriousness of bearing, which many families regard as dignity rather than severity.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabis verified?
faq.a: Yes. The meaning Frowning; austere rests on the Arabic active participle ʿābis, from the root ʿ-b-s.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aabis?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabis total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and completion. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aabis?
faq.a: Variants and alternative transliterations include Abis and Aabes.

faq.q: Where is the name Aabis used today?
faq.a: Aabis circulates chiefly in Arabic naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
